title: Distribution Shift in Red-Team Judging: Per-Model-Style Calibration Error

original_idea.body: Per-model-style judge calibration error (extends arXiv:2603.14633, arXiv:2603.06594): same prompts across 4 stylistically different open models, one judge + human labels, isolate style as a confound in judge error.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Isolating style confound in judges improves field-wide robustness comparisons; concrete, defensible chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Same prompts across 4 models + one judge + human labels; conceptually simple, labeling is labor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped per-model judge-error isolation with controlled prompts.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Field-wide evaluation reliability, public models, careful labeling; high counterfactual value.

novelty.reasoning: Style-confound flagged by sources; clean isolation is a partly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Style confound flagged; clean isolation may be open.
